Messages.Author: Chuck Arnett
Messages.Body:
If The Barron has Into the fire played on him, Then plays Go Anarch!
does he get his 2 votes back? My guess is yes.

If he then plays Fee Stake Corte does does he then lose the 2 votes on
his card again? My guess is yes.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chuck Arnett wrote:
> If The Barron has Into the fire played on him, Then plays Go Anarch!
> does he get his 2 votes back? My guess is yes.

"Baron". The title is inactive as long as he remains non-anarch. If he
becomes anarch again (without losing the inactive title in the meantime
to contesting or by gaining a different title, for example), then the
title becomes active again.

> If he then plays Fee Stake Corte does does he then lose the 2 votes on
> his card again? My guess is yes.

Any titled vampire loses his title when he gains a new one.

>"Baron".

i think he meant "The Baron", 9 cap Samedi.

To which the answer is: the (2 votes) title of The Baron is not tied
to his sect, so he retains it even if he goes Into the Fire. Thus,
being titled, he is not eligible to become an Anarch, making the rest
of the questions not applicable.
